property_snapshot.Name: Ethereal Diadem
property_snapshot.Notes:
PHYSICAL: Diadem with properties enhancing perception beyond material boundaries.

PROPERTIES:
• Enhances perception across planar boundaries
• See into ethereal and adjacent planes
• Extends sensory range into normally invisible dimensions

ORIGIN: Acquired from Raazalkul's hoard. Part of Arik's negotiated share.

STATUS: Currently stored for future use rather than actively worn. Reserved for dimensional research.

property_snapshot.Name: Command Circlet
property_snapshot.Notes:
PHYSICAL: Ancient alloy circlet with diamond inlays. Matron unconsciously touches it - habit growing more pronounced as influence deepens.

PROPERTIES:
• Subtle influence over wearer's decisions
• Creates general alignment with creator's objectives
• Causes physical touching habit in wearer
• Potential dependency development with extended use
• Adjusted to reduce crude domination in favor of subtle influence

SOUL COMPOSITION:
• Dhusyl Hunzrin's commanding presence (primary)
• Illithid soul reserved for future enhancement

ORIGIN: Ancient circlet acquired through Bregan D'aerthe. Infused with Dhusyl Hunzrin's soul (Session 5) specifically harvested for commanding presence.

DESIGN PHILOSOPHY: Creates leader who functions effectively while remaining amenable to guidance rather than crude domination. Matron's natural intelligence continues operating alongside influence.

POTENTIAL: May be refined for transfer to other targets (Matron Hunzrin, Pharizia).
property_snapshot.Origin: Dodecahedron crafted — Dhusyl Hunzrin soul (illithid reserved for upgrade)

property_snapshot.Name: Soul-Enhanced Hand Crossbow
property_snapshot.Notes:
CREATED: Session 2

SOUL SOURCE: Half-orc warrior soul (predatory instincts)

PROPERTIES:
• Guided projectiles (minor course correction mid-flight)
• Extended accuracy range
• Enhanced penetration

DESIGN: Ranged assassination tool. Bolts seek targets with unnatural accuracy.

STATUS: VAULTED for heir - superseded by current loadout.

property_snapshot.Name: Wong Fei's Stone
property_snapshot.Notes:
TYPE: Ioun Stone

PHYSICAL: Orbits Selarial's head in gentle rotation, creating subtle protective aura.

PROPERTIES:
• Protective capabilities
• Regenerative capabilities
• Complements elven combat style

ORIGIN: Acquired by triplet mages specifically for Selarial. Named after merchant from whom it was obtained. Presented alongside linked bag of holding before Abyssal Raid.

SIGNIFICANCE: Gift from triplets demonstrating recognition of Selarial's value to the network. Enhances her considerable presence.

property_snapshot.Name: Void-Enhanced Armor
property_snapshot.Notes:
ORIGIN: Conventional armor damaged during Void Hunter encounter, infused with Void Hunter essence through Dodecahedron.

PHYSICAL: No longer reflects light consistently. Certain angles reveal depths that shouldn't exist. Portions feel simultaneously solid and insubstantial. Ripples with non-Euclidean patterns. Weighs less than before.

PROPERTIES:
• Partial dimensional shifting
• Reality distortion (difficult to perceive/target)
• Protection against planar attacks
• Modular dimensional state (shift portions more/less substantial)
• Enhanced spatial awareness
• Unprecedented responsiveness to movement
• Protective barrier against dimensional manipulation

SYNERGIES:
• Responds to Shadow Monks' dimensional phasing
• Amplifies Arik's phasing capabilities
• Complements Dodecahedron's dimensional awareness

SIGNIFICANCE: First integration of extra-dimensional essence rather than conventional souls. Major evolution in soul enhancement capabilities.

STATUS: VAULTED - superseded by Pale Death Armor.

property_snapshot.Name: Cloak of Refracted Light
property_snapshot.Notes:
TYPE: Assassin's cloak

PHYSICAL: Cloak that bends light around wearer. Appears to shimmer at edges, colors shifting based on viewing angle.

PROPERTIES:
• Advantage on Stealth checks in ANY light conditions (not just darkness)
• 1/day Greater Invisibility that doesn't break on attacks for 1 round
• Reduces light-based damage by half
• Difficult to track visually even when visible

ORIGIN: Acquired from Raazalkul's hoard. Demon lord likely used it or kept it from a particularly skilled mortal assassin.

STATUS: Stored in vault. Perfect for Veil operative or vaulted for heir.

POTENTIAL RECIPIENTS: Senior Veil agent, Lirien's second, or high-value assassination mission loadout.

property_snapshot.Name: Dimensional Anchor Pendant
property_snapshot.Notes:
PHYSICAL: Black stone on silver chain that absorbs light.

PROPERTIES:
• Stabilizes wearer's position when traversing dimensional boundaries
• Crucial for extradimensional sanctuary development
• Prevents unwanted planar displacement

ORIGIN: Acquired from Raazalkul's treasure hoard during Abyssal Raid. Specifically selected for dimensional research applications.

SYNERGIES:
• Supports dimensional phasing development
• Complements void-enhanced armor
• Works with Dodecahedron's planar manipulation

property_snapshot.Name: Vial of Purified Souls
property_snapshot.Notes:
PHYSICAL: Small crystal vial containing what appears to be swirling mist - actually souls in their most refined form.

PROPERTIES:
• Contains souls in purest form
• Ideal research material for soul manipulation experiments
• Purpose unknown (demon lord clearly harvested for special purpose)

ORIGIN: Acquired from Raazalkul's treasure hoard during Abyssal Raid.

STATUS: Reserved for experimental research rather than immediate use. Research material for Dodecahedron experiments.

property_snapshot.Name: Ring of Abyssal Authority
property_snapshot.Notes:
DISTRIBUTED: Given to enforcer devil during Dis Gambit treasure division.

FUNCTION: Aids in converting captured demonic enemies. Psychological warfare tool.

STATUS: In allied hands. Full stats TBD if devil returns with item.

property_snapshot.Name: Anti-Detection Amulet
property_snapshot.Notes:
CREATED: Session 7

SOUL SOURCE: Derro savant soul (partially consumed from Dodecahedron reserves)

PROPERTIES:
• Masks soul energy signatures
• Protects against essence-draining attacks
• Disrupts magical tracking
• Detection of surveillance attempts (grows warm)
• Complete invisibility to divination

HISTORY: Warned of Hellish Sigil in Sorcere. Essential for maintaining secrecy of soul manipulation activities.

STATUS: VAULTED for heir - critical operational security tool.

property_snapshot.Name: Forge of Infinite Forms
property_snapshot.Notes:
DISTRIBUTED: Given to transmuter devil during Dis Gambit treasure division.

FUNCTION: Gauntlet allowing weapon transmutation (3/day), maintains magical properties through transformation.

STATUS: In allied hands. Full stats TBD if devil returns with item.

property_snapshot.Name: Soul-Enhanced Kukri
property_snapshot.Notes:
CREATED: Session 2 - First successful soul weapon, proof of concept.

SOUL SOURCE: Drow warrior souls

PROPERTIES:
• Identifies anatomical weaknesses in targets
• Supernatural speed enhancement during combat
• Self-maintaining edge (never dulls)
• Visual obscurity during motion (difficult to track)

DESIGN: Primary melee weapon for close assassination work. Blade moves faster than eye can follow.

STATUS: VAULTED for heir - superseded by Pale Death Armor's integrated combat suite.

property_snapshot.Name: Linked Bags of Holding
property_snapshot.Notes:
PHYSICAL: Paired extradimensional containers of fine craftsmanship.

PROPERTIES:
• Paired extradimensional spaces
• Object transfer regardless of physical distance
• Functions across planar boundaries (per triplets' calculations)
• Can hold up to a ton of weight combined
• Connection can be temporarily sealed via Dodecahedron

ORIGIN: Crafted by triplet mages through their own initiative. Presented to Selarial before Abyssal Raid along with Wong Fei's Stone.

PROVEN: Demonstrated value during raid when treasures materialized in Selarial's bag as Arik claimed them.

MECHANICS: Standard bag capacity, items placed in one appear in other, 1-mile range (confirmed), 1-round delay.

property_snapshot.Name: Crystalline Focus Lenses
property_snapshot.Notes:
TYPE: Demon lord's scrying equipment

PHYSICAL: Set of crystalline lenses that fit over eyes or can be mounted in frames. Surface shifts with captured light from other planes.

PROPERTIES:
• True seeing through specific planar boundaries
• Record visual information for later playback
• Overlay psychic impressions with visual data (Kimmuriel application)
• Detect invisible/ethereal entities
• See through magical darkness

ORIGIN: Acquired from Raazalkul's hoard during Abyssal Raid. Allocated to Bregan D'aerthe during treasure division.

CURRENT USE: Kimmuriel uses for psionic intelligence enhancement - combining with his mental abilities for superior reconnaissance.

ALLIANCE VALUE: Strengthens Bregan D'aerthe intelligence capabilities.

property_snapshot.Name: Paws of the Cheetah
property_snapshot.Notes:
PHYSICAL: Magical boots of speed that flicker in and out of visibility.

PROPERTIES:
• Supernatural quickness
• Movements become almost blurry with speed

ORIGIN: Acquired from Raazalkul's hoard. Zaknafein immediately equipped them during raid - his personal claim.

SYNERGIES: Complements Gram for enhanced combat capability. Allows Zaknafein to match Arik's dimensional phasing with raw speed.

ALLIANCE VALUE: Strengthens Bregan D'aerthe partnership through tangible combat enhancement.

property_snapshot.Name: Boots of Temporal Displacement
property_snapshot.Notes:
PHYSICAL: Boots that flicker in and out of visibility. Temporal properties create subtle displacement effects.

PROPERTIES:
• Limited manipulation of personal time flow
• Temporal displacement for combat advantage
• Full capabilities not yet explored

ORIGIN: Acquired from Raazalkul's hoard. Negotiated as part of Arik's share in exchange for giving Juggernaut Golem Manual to Bregan D'aerthe.

SYNERGIES: Complements dimensional manipulation abilities.
